summary.headline: Messahala on Thoughts
summary.text: Conclusion of Messahala’s book on the signification of the planets in nativities, followed by the opening of “On Thoughts.” The section explains interrogations, establishing the ascendant and houses, identifying the significator through planetary lords, dignities, aspects, angles, and fortune, and judging the strength and goodness of its placement.
